prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Welcome Your New Companion to Your Desktop!", "Your pet is ready to live on your desktop. Here is how to summon, control, and play with your companion anytime.", "Press Option+Space to toggle companion controls"]
1: ["Official Pet Adoption Certificate", "Review your pet details and confirm adoption to bring your companion home.", "Verified Desktop Pet"]
2: ["Select Your Journey", "Choose whether you want a curated standard companion or a custom AI-generated pet."]
3: ["Preparing Desktop Overlay", "Your pet will live active in the corner of your desktop screen. Click Continue to place your companion.", "Launch Companion"]
4: ["Sign In to Save Your Pet", "Sync your adoption across devices and secure your desktop companion data.", "Continue with Account"]
5: ["Choose Companion & Voice Tone", "Select your companion and preview their sound effects before proceeding.", "Preview Companion Sound"]
6: ["Bringing Your Pet to Life", "We are generating your desktop companion animations and companion profile."]
7: ["Upload a Clear, Well-Lit Photo", "Choose a front-facing photo of your pet with clear lighting for the best desktop rendering results.", "Select Photo"]
8: ["Quick Tip: Press Shift + Esc anytime to toggle your pet on or off your desktop screen."]
9: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Companion", "Build an interactive pet companion that stays on your computer screen while you work and play."]
